spans.s:
च्यु {vI.v} {c1c} A. (च्यवते, च्युत)
1 To fall
or drop down, slip, sink (fig. also);
Ś. 2. 8.
--2 To come out of, flow or
issue from, drop, trickle or stream
forth from; स्वतश्चयुतं वह्निमिवाद्भिरंबुदः

.
--3 To deviate
or swerve from, fall off or away
from, leave (duty &c.); (with abl.)
अस्माद्धर्मान्न च्यवेत

.
--6
To decrease.
--7 To bring about,
make, form, create.
--8 To cause to go
away, cause to forget. --Caus. (
च्यावयति-ते)
1 To cause to move, excite,
agitate.
--2 (A.) To move oneself, be
shaken or moved.
--3 To remove,
drive away, expel.
--4 To deprive,
take away;

.
--5 To cause
to fall. {vII.v} {c10c} P. (च्यावयति)
1 To
suffer, bear.
--2 To laugh.

च्युत p. p. [च्यु-क्त च्युत्-क वा]
1
Fallen down, slipped, fallen.
--2
Removed, expelled.
--3 Strayed,
[]
erred, deviated from.
--4 Deprived.
--5 Broken, disordered.
--6 Dropped,
oozed out.
--7 Lost, gone, perished;

.
--8 Moved, shaken.
--Comp.
--अधिकार a. dismissed
from office.
--आत्मन् a. of a
depraved soul, evil-minded;

च्युतिः f. [च्यु-भावे क्तिन्]
1 Falling
down, a fall.
--2 Deviation from.
--3
Dropping, oozing.
--4 Losing,
deprivation; धैर्यच्युतिं कुर्यां

.
--5
Vanishing, perishing.
--6 The vulva.
--7 The anus.
--8 Quick motion.

च्युत् {c1c} P. (च्योतति)
1 To drop,
flow, ooze, trickle, stream forth;
इदं शोणितमभ्यग्रं संप्रहारेऽच्युतत्तयोः

.
--2 To drop or fall down,
slip; इदं कवचमच्योतीत्

.
--3 To cause to drop or stream
forth.
--4 To wet thoroughly,
moisten.
च्युपः The face, mouth.

च्युस् {c10c} P. (च्योसयति)
1 To
laugh.
--2 To suffer.
--3 To leave.
--4 To hurt, kill.
--5 To loose.
च्यूतः The mango tree.
